description: This file provides utility functions for persisting and retrieving user profile data in a Supabase backend, focusing on fields that map to the 'public.users' table and handling location data with fallback to 'career_preferences'. It includes functions for upserting and loading user profiles, managing location support, and handling authentication sessions.

methods.name: safeTrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string, converting nullish values to empty strings.

methods.name: normalizeNullable
methods.description: Trims a value and returns null if the result is an empty string.

methods.name: serializeSupabaseError
methods.description: Creates a JSON summary of a Supabase error for logging or display.

methods.name: getAuthSessionOrReason
methods.description: Retrieves the current authentication session or provides a reason if unavailable.

methods.name: usersHasLocationColumn
methods.description: Checks if the 'users' table has a 'location' column for the given user ID.

methods.name: upsertUserBasicProfile
methods.description: Upserts basic user profile data into 'public.users', with fallback to 'career_preferences' for location if needed.

methods.name: upsertPreferredLocation
methods.description: Updates or inserts the user's preferred location in 'career_preferences'.

methods.name: loadUserBasicProfile
methods.description: Loads basic user profile data, including fallback location if 'users.location' is unsupported.
